scope: CPU finite verification only; no production model, training, reverse chains or GPU
score: Reuse frozen 20261108 JointLocalScore: per-type joint relation-degree and typed-triangle MMD. No connectivity term; not the later proposed assignment score.
rebar_coefficient: One analytic covariance coefficient per probability profile, fitted on independent development samples in logit space then frozen. No clipping, temperature search or evaluation-based selection.
references: all-coordinate conditional differences (exact variance reference, no sampled-edge estimator)
parameter_mapping: Fixed synthetic 10x4 Jacobian with a common column and three random columns; algebra only, not the actual neural model
timing: Standalone K=16 estimators, 2 warmups and 12 paired timed repeats, includes random generation and score computation; no model cost. Variance*time is a diagnostic proxy, not equal-wall training evidence.
decision: Report all probability profiles and batch sizes, exact bias checks, MSE and descent direction rates, sparse rare-event misses, estimator time. No automatic training; mathematical correctness alone is insufficient.
